items.name: Lexington Feet Fest 2019

venue.name: Follen Church
venue.details: Please enter through the side entrance on the building.

items.information: **3x3x3 With Feet is the main event of this competition!** 3x3 With Feet will be the only event held at this competition. We will NOT be holding usual events like 3x3. If you are a new competitor or looking for more normal events, this probably isn't for you, and you may want to check out other local competitions.

items.name: Oklahoma 2020
items.information: Please note that this schedule is subject to change, as we may hold events slightly earlier or later than shown depending on whether the competition is running ahead of schedule or behind schedule. This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors should be familiar with the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, you may want to look at CubingUSA's Competitor [Tutorial](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww&t=2s).
